name: Université Grenoble Alpes IDEX Master's Scholarship (IdEx Formation)
requiredDocuments: An application to one (or several) of the eligible Master's / Engineer degrees offered by a UGA academic division (ENSAG, Grenoble INP, Sciences Po Grenoble, or UGA) for the 2026-2027 academic year — there is no separate scholarship dossier; the degree application IS the scholarship application

Academic records / transcripts — selection is made by the Master's academic team on the basis of academic record and high academic potential (exact documents depend on each degree's own application; check the program page)

Indication of your wish to apply for the IdEx scholarship — either ticked online in the Master's application, or, where not possible, sent by email to the School Registrar and/or Head of the curriculum
After award only (not at application): a French or SEPA-area bank account in your own name and your RIB/IBAN, registered on the IdEx platform, before any instalment is paid

timeline.opens: March 2026 (scholarship requests open March–July; the underlying degree application calendars vary and open earlier)
timeline.deadline: July 2026 (IdEx scholarship requests open March to July; the binding deadline is each degree program's own application deadline, which is often earlier)
timeline.resultsBy: Results sent shortly after each admission committee sits; scholarship notification may arrive after the degree-admission decision
timeline.notes: Cycle is 2026-2027 (FAQ version 01 Dec 2025; call page updated 11 Dec 2025). As of the 2026-06 anchor this is the live, currently-open cycle. The candidate 2025-2026 URL redirects to the live 2026-2027 call. There is no single fixed scholarship deadline — applications are tied to each Master's own calendar, are open March–July, and are processed on the basis of 'best files plus chronological order of arrival', so applying early matters. Apply against your specific program's deadline.

benefits: Fixed annual cash grant, net and tax-free, spread over 10 months: maximum 9,000 EUR for a Master's first year (M1 / Engineer 2A)
Maximum 5,500 EUR for a Master's second year (M2 / Engineer 3A)
Paid in two equal 50% instalments — first around mid-October (after registration/attendance confirmed and tuition paid), second in February (after first-semester attendance/exams confirmed)
Optional assistance with the student-accommodation search (subject to conditions; housing is NOT guaranteed)
mustKnow: NOT a tuition waiver and NOT fully funded: the official FAQ states 'Obtaining an IdEx scholarship does not exempt you from paying tuition fees.' Any fee exemption is a separate decision made by each individual Master's program.
You must pay your tuition first — the first scholarship instalment is released only after you have paid due tuition fees (mid-October at the earliest), so you need funds to cover enrolment up front.

It is a partial cash grant only (max 9,000 EUR/yr for M1, 5,500 EUR/yr for M2) — there is no separate living stipend, travel, or insurance on top, and a Bangladeshi applicant will need substantial additional funds to cover tuition + full cost of living in Grenoble.

Two-step process: there is no standalone scholarship form. You first apply to an eligible UGA Master's/Engineer degree and indicate your wish for the IdEx scholarship; the degree's academic team selects the awardees. You can be admitted to the degree without getting the scholarship.
Granted for ONE academic year only — to keep funding into M2 you must apply again; it does not auto-renew.

Eligibility is strictly for incoming international students: currently enrolled in a university outside France, OR last degree from a foreign university, OR baccalauréat obtained abroad. Not all UGA degrees give access to an IdEx scholarship.
Payment requires a French or SEPA-zone bank account in your own name (RIB/IBAN registered on the IdEx platform) — non-trivial to set up before your first instalment.
Award cannot be stacked: if you hold another scholarship its amount is deducted so the total does not exceed the IdEx amount.

universities: Grenoble INP - UGA (Institut polytechnique de Grenoble)
ENSAG - UGA (École nationale supérieure d'architecture de Grenoble)

duration: 1 academic year (10 months); not renewable automatically — reapply for the second year
eligibleNationalities: Open to all foreign/international nationalities (Bangladesh included). Eligibility is residence/education-based, not nationality-based: you must be currently enrolled at a university outside France, or have obtained your last degree at a foreign university, or have obtained your baccalauréat abroad. No nationality restriction and no age limit are stated.
fundingCovers: Partial living costs (fixed annual cash grant only — does NOT cover or waive tuition)
monthlyStipend: No fixed monthly stipend; the grant is a lump annual amount (max 9,000 EUR for M1 or 5,500 EUR for M2) paid in two instalments over the year
renewalConditions: Not renewable automatically; the award is for one academic year only. To continue into the second year, the holder must apply again. Instalments are conditioned on the program confirming registration and attendance/exam participation.
